name: SiS Distribution (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: SiS Distribution (Thailand) Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, distributes computer components, smartphones, and office automation equipment in Thailand. It operates in four segments: Commercial Products, Consumer Products, Value Added Products, and Phones. The company is also involved in the servicing and rental of computers and accessories. SiS Distribution (Thailand) Public Company Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand.
